in_marathi.name: Gireesh
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of the mountain
in_marathi.long_meaning: Gireesh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Gireesh is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Giri' meaning mountain and 'Ish' meaning Lord. This name is used to describe the one who rules over the mountains or is considered a guardian of the mountains in Hindu mythology.
